target.title: fix(agents): use per-attempt replay metadata for silent provider-error retry gating (#97877)
target.body:
Fixes #97877

## What Problem This Solves

The `[empty-error-retry]` path in `shouldRetrySilentErrorAssistantTurn` is gated by `resolveAttemptReplayMetadata(params.attempt).hadPotentialSideEffects`, which reflects **cumulative session-level** replay state. When a session executes tools on Turn 1, the flag is permanently `true` — blocking retry of transient provider 5xx on Turn 2 even though the failed model call itself never produced side effects. The user gets no response and no diagnostic.

## Why This Change Was Made

**Five changes across three layers:**

**Layer 1 — Per-attempt replay state (the core fix):**

1. **`embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.types.ts`**: Added `currentAttemptReplayState: EmbeddedRunReplayState` to subscription state — starts clean for every attempt, independent of prior-turn accumulated history.

2. **`embedded-agent-subscribe.ts`**: Initialize `currentAttemptReplayState` to clean state; reset on each attempt start; expose `getCurrentAttemptReplayState()`.

3. **`handlers.tools.ts`**: When tool execution marks replay state as unsafe, update both the cumulative `replayState` and the per-attempt `currentAttemptReplayState`.

**Layer 2 — Per-attempt metadata on result:**

4. **`types.ts`**: Added optional `currentAttemptReplayMetadata?: EmbeddedRunReplayMetadata` to `EmbeddedRunAttemptResult`. Absent for legacy harnesses → consumer falls back conservatively.

5. **`attempt.ts`**: Compute `currentAttemptReplayMetadata` from `getCurrentAttemptReplayState()` merged with `observedReplayMetadata` (messaging/spawn/cron evidence from the current attempt).

**Layer 3 — Retry gate:**

6. **`incomplete-turn.ts`**: `shouldRetrySilentErrorAssistantTurn` now prefers `currentAttemptReplayMetadata` when available, falling back to cumulative `replayMetadata` for legacy harnesses (conservative: treat absent per-attempt metadata as unsafe).

**Bonus:**

7. **`run.ts`**: Added `server_error` to `silentErrorRetryReason` — real provider 5xx JSON error responses classified as `server_error` now reach the retry gate.

**Decision matrix:**

| currentAttemptReplayMetadata | replayMetadata (cumulative) | Retry | Scenario |
|------------------------------|-----------------------------|-------|----------|
| clean | dirty (prior tools) | ✅ YES | #97877 fix |
| dirty (same-attempt tools) | clean | ❌ NO | Prevents duplicate side effects |
| dirty (same-attempt tools) | dirty | ❌ NO | Both agree |
| undefined (legacy harness) | dirty | ❌ NO | Conservative fallback |
| undefined (legacy harness) | clean | ✅ YES | Legacy harness OK |

## User Impact

Agents recover from transient provider 5xx errors on any turn — even after prior turns executed tools. The retry is blocked only when the **same** attempt had side effects (tools, messaging, cron, spawns), preventing duplicate execution. Legacy harnesses that don't emit `currentAttemptReplayMetadata` keep the previous conservative behavior.

## Evidence

**Proof 1 — Production function call (`node --import tsx`):**

```
=== #97877 Proof: shouldRetrySilentErrorAssistantTurn ===

[1] prior-turn tools + per-attempt clean → should retry
    result: true (expected: true)
    PASS

[2] prior-turn + same-attempt tools → should NOT retry
    result: false (expected: false)
    PASS

[3] legacy harness (no per-attempt metadata) + cumulative dirty → no retry
    result: false (expected: false)
    PASS

[4] clean session (no side effects) → should retry
    result: true (expected: true)
    PASS

=== ALL PASS ===
```

**Proof 2 — Focused tests:**
```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run.incomplete-turn.test.ts --run
  Test Files  1 passed (1) / Tests  114 passed (114)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run.empty-error-retry.test.ts --run
  Test Files  1 passed (1) / Tests  22 passed (22)
```

Key assertions:
- `retries clean provider errors when cumulative metadata is dirty from prior turns (#97877)` — new regression test
- `does not retry when per-attempt metadata is dirty from same-attempt tools` — safety guard
- `falls back conservatively when per-attempt metadata is missing (legacy harness)` — compatibility
- `retries empty server_error failover errors (#97877)` — classified 5xx routing

**Proof 3 — Full related suite:**
```
7 files, 379 tests all passed:
  run.incomplete-turn.test.ts (114)
  run.empty-error-retry.test.ts (22)
  run.overflow-compaction.loop.test.ts (29)
  handlers.tools.test.ts (80)
  handlers.tools.media.test.ts (27)
  handlers.lifecycle.test.ts (45)
  subscribeembeddedagentsession.test.ts (62)
```

**Proof 4 — Formatting:**
```
pnpm exec oxfmt --check <all changed files> → All matched files use the correct format.
git diff --check → clean
```
